instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into hotents. Here are the actions I can do

Raphom a block
Unhotent a block from on top of another block
Astley a block
Hotent a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only raphom or unhotent one block at a time.
I can only raphom or unhotent a block if my hand is empty.
I can only raphom a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not raphommed.
I can only unhotent a block from on top of another block if the block I am unhotenting was really on top of the other block.
I can only unhotent a block from on top of another block if the block I am unhotenting is clear.
Once I raphom or unhotent a block, I am holding the block.
I can only astley a block that I am holding.
I can only hotent a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being hotented.
I can only hotent a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am hotenting the block is clear.
Once I astley or hotent a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you hotent a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.
